title: A relayed owner ruling cites the question it answered, and the send-time judge checks the relayed rule is no wider than that question
why: Retrospective 14:03 CST Nov 13, its own mistake at 13:29: it relayed "round 3 no longer occurs" as a rule for every change, when the owner was answering item 741 (skip round 3 after a pass). Round 3 was wrongly dropped from lanes for about 30 minutes.
note: Todo, candidate. Guard: a relayed ruling names the item or question it answered; the send-time judge (SendMessage wording judge, step past-ruling-on-send) checks the relayed rule is no wider than that question. Red case: the 13:2x relay against item 741. Triage's own relays of the same words (13:31 and later, ruling r9 text) took the wide reading too and were corrected 14:0x CST. Past rulings not checked.
